summary: For an external database, run psql and pg_restore from any node with access. In psql, give each database owner `CREATEDB` (`ALTER ROLE awx WITH CREATEDB;`), restore with `pg_restore --clean --create --no-owner -h <host> -U <user> -d template1 <component>/<component>.pgc` from `/var/lib/pgsql/backups`, then remove it with `ALTER ROLE awx WITH NOCREATEDB;`.
questions: How do I pg_restore the AAP migration dumps?
Why does the AAP database owner need CREATEDB for restore?
Can I restore to an external database from any node?

answer_card.title: Restore each component database
answer_card.answer_md:
```sql
ALTER ROLE awx WITH CREATEDB;   -- each DB owner
```
```bash
cd /var/lib/pgsql/backups
pg_restore --clean --create --no-owner -h <pg_hostname> -U <component_pg_user> \
  -d template1 <component>/<component>.pgc
```
```sql
ALTER ROLE awx WITH NOCREATEDB;
```
